sentences.text: IBAC reported on illicit drug use by Victoria Police officers and the systems intended to prevent and detect it.
sentences.support: broader consideration of Victoria Police’s systems and practices to detect and prevent illicit drug use by its officers

sentences.text: It drew on Operations Apsley, Hotham and Yarrowitch, which examined drug use and officers’ associations with criminal figures.
sentences.support: Both investigations examined the police officers’ subsequent associations with criminal figures

sentences.text: IBAC found that illicit drug use had become routine within a connected group of officers and identified weaknesses in policy, recruitment and drug testing.
sentences.support: Operation Apsley identified a group of interconnected police officers for whom illicit drug use was an accepted and regular part

sentences.text: It made two recommendations for a comprehensive review of police drug use and controls, followed by progress and final reports on improvements.
sentences.support: undertake a comprehensive review of the use of illicit drugs by Victoria Police officers

findings.quote: Operation Apsley identified a group of interconnected police officers for whom illicit drug use was an accepted and regular part of their social lives.
IBAC considers the investigations detailed in this report are likely to represent only snapshots of a more widespread and serious problem for Victoria Police.

notes: No individual officers are named. Reported charges, suspensions and disciplinary outcomes are not described as findings of criminal guilt. Two numbered recommendations include implementation reporting.
